title: Canada Goose to Announce First Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results on July 30, 2026
summary: Canada Goose Holdings Inc. (NYSE, TSX: GOOS) plans to announce results for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, which ended June 28, 2026, before markets open on Thursday, July 30, 2026. The Company will host a conference call and webcast to discuss first quarter fiscal 2027 results at 8:30am ET on Thursday, July 30, 2026. A live webcast of the conference call will be available on the company’s website at http://investor.canadagoose.com . The conference call can be accessed by using the following link: Canada Goose Q1 2027 Earnings Call . After registering, an email including the conference call link will be sent to join the live call. An archived replay of the webcast will be available shortly after the conclusion of the call.
